# IMAP STATUS defers unselected-folder notification until local flags synchronize

This landing syncs flags before setting the new-mail count and keeps biff pending when an unselected folder reports a positive fresh unseen delta. A selected folder may announce immediately, while the unselected path updates the folder and later header completion applies its own notification guards. Actual header-flag and NoMail branches show how a read/new transition can clear a per-folder count, so the ordering has a concrete scoped consumer. Fake-server tests assert one positive notification and reconciled counts, but no OS sleep, native alert or real second-device run was performed.

Scope: IMAP biff count and notification ordering.
